title: What AI tool do you want but don't have?
author: doggy-smiles
selftext:
Are there any AI tools that you would use that don't exist yet? Are there tools that already exist that don't work well enough or suit your needs?

The questions are engine agnostic. I am looking for ideas to build in Unreal Engine, though.

Thanks

comments.author: tomqmasters
comments.body: AI 3d animation is basically nonexistent except for humanoid movement and even then it's still very new.

replies.author: doggy-smiles
replies.body: Can you please expand on this? What animation systems do you think are lacking? Creatures, animals, vehicles, etc.?

replies.author: Revelation12Studios
replies.body: 3D AI animation tools that lack are for those you mentioned; basically anything that is not humanoid.

replies.author: Atoning_Unifex
replies.body:
Like, im trying to make a Spider Tank game and finding something help me make sprites for it is very challenging. There's tools but most are focused on like 8-bit graphics. This is a spec drawing for what I want. I haven't found anything to speed up making sprites at this level of resolution. And Ive tried a few.

https://preview.redd.it/oy7udb9xe0vg1.png?width=2035&format=png&auto=webp&s=9646ffabe871b339bfc1905e9b085ca7fdf65b46

replies.author: tomqmasters
replies.body: I guess it would need to be the "anything I want" category because if you try to make something too specific, you might as well put out an animation pack and then people just use that.

comments.author: RelapseCatAddict
comments.body:
I want a AI tool that doesn't use credits any longer! 

But For UE I would love to have an AI tool that can assist in creating the Blueprints stringing them all together lovely. 

I know Bezi AI is attached to Unity engine So i hope someone makes something like that for UE

replies.author: doggy-smiles
replies.body:
Thanks for your input! What tools specifically do you want to be credit-free?  
  
I have an idea for Blueprint generation, but I haven't explored it much. The main thing holding me back is compute costs needed to train a custom model.

replies.author: Dan_Fury
replies.body:
I want a tool that allows me to create 1 second loops with Grok imagine through subscription.
Sorceress has this functionality,but only supports it through API. 
Nano Banana to Grok imagine to Sorceress Corridorkey is such a sexy workflow, here is a fresh video about it I watched yesterday, any tool that could make this workflow easier would be good tier:
https://youtu.be/tU2Q99plP1Q?si=w324SQNARcTBRBqd

comments.author: hugejew
comments.body: I would pay for a great parallax background tool. Specifically the ability to give it dimensions, feed it style references, and have it output multiple layers with transparency or even just single isolated elements reliably with consistent style.

comments.author: Pretend_Prior_8423
comments.body: I'm hoping there's a way to make animations from art that you have.

replies.author: Bluetails_Buizel
replies.body: Moho isn’t free. But there are tools out there like photoshop where you can puppet warp tool / add bones to your characters and animate them

replies.author: Pretend_Prior_8423
replies.body: I have 2d art, so I don't think they will work with bones. They don't have angles or T poses.

replies.body: I'm not really sure what you mean, aren't most animation models intended for img2vid? Just use Wan2.2

comments.author: OcelotHot5287
comments.body: for concept art and storyboarding, most devs end up stitching together separate tools which gets old fast. Mage Space (mage .space) works well for unified visual workflows, though ComfyUI gives more controll if you need engine-specific outputs.
